verdict.rationale: Antigravity ships an Agent SDK and CLI that expose 'the same tools, agent loop, and context management' as the UI, plus MCP/plugin/skill extensibility, suggesting meaningful programmatic parity — but there is no documented public REST/OpenAPI API, and probes explicitly found no OpenAPI spec (404s across candidate endpoints), so UI-only features like Remote Control, Scheduled Tasks UI, and Artifact review workflows are not confirmed to be fully API-accessible. Missing for 10: a documented general-purpose API/OpenAPI spec, confirmation that all UI features (scheduling, remote control, artifact review) are reachable via SDK/CLI, and independent verification of parity.
